reviewBasis: Visual inspection of native atlas artwork plus directional outside-edge evidence from the production map reader. Names describe artwork; regional use comes from database map titles. Adjacency candidates are not approved automatically.

routes.reason: Dirt tiles bake rough grass. Fine grass must first transition through the native fine-to-rough grass atlas.

rejectedBlends.reason: The dirt transition's baked rough grass does not match the fine-grass centre texture. Direct placement produces a hard rectangular light/dark grass seam; native adjacency is not sufficient evidence.
